desc:
🔫 Welcome to Shoot To Escape! 🧱

Something is behind these walls... and you have a gun. 👀
Blast your way through 14 walls and ESCAPE THE BUNKER!

How to play:
🔫 Shoot the wall and watch it crumble!
🧲 Vacuum up the blocks you break
💰 Sell them on the conveyor for cash
⬆️ Buy bigger guns: Pistol ➜ Sniper ➜ Minigun ➜ RPG ➜ Railgun ➜ Quasar Cannon!
🧨 Throw dynamite and blow huge craters
💎 Find gems, chests, gold rushes & relics in the walls
🚪 Break through room after room to reach the Final Wall

👥 Play solo or with up to 4 friends!
😈 Beat Beginner to unlock Medium... then Hard!
🎲 Roll classes & unlock drones that shoot with you
🎁 Daily rewards & quests

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
💰 Join the group for +10% cash forever!

How many walls can YOU break? 🧱💥
